messages:
alex: FYI seeing a 15-25% p95 regression on short (<=128) prompts after today's runtime deploy. traces point at attention path.
priya: ugh. any obvious changelist? can you paste perf numbers? :eyes:
dan: initial glance: kernel selection flipped to flashattn_v2 for half of the traces. nvprof shows flash_v2 kernel time up ~1.6x for seq=128.
eva: also saw more KV cache misses in the same window. delta in kv-cache hit rate ~ -12% on sampled traffic.
alex: quick before/after from canary traffic:
```
Before (commit abc123): p95=24ms p99=45ms mean=8.3ms
After  (commit def456): p95=31ms p99=68ms mean=9.1ms
```
bench-bot: auto-bench summary (microbench, seq=128, batch=4): flashattn_v1 median 7.9ms, flashattn_v2 median 12.6ms, fused_attn median 8.2ms.
priya: interesting that fused is close to v1. Did kernel selector odds go up for v2 on 128? selector config was changed in PR #4321 iirc.
dan: yes selector rule changed to pick v2 for <256 when quantized==true. that PR landed this morning.
eva: KV behavior might amplify latency if cache coldstart coincides with slower kernel (longer per-token = longer total request -> fewer cache-ready prefixes).
alex: timeline idea: 1) confirm kernel selector flip rate per model/seq, 2) confirm KV hit-rate regressions overlap in time, 3) bisect PR range around #4321 and related compile changes.
priya: I ran a small trace sample. selector flips to v2 in ~48% of short requests post-deploy (was ~3% before).
bench-bot: quick flamegraph diff attached (summary):
- flash_attn_kernel (v2) shows hot spot 30% larger in compute loop; more branch mispredicts.
dan: actionable: repro locally with the exact model + flags. run:
```
./tools/attn_perf --model=chat-small --seq=128 --batch=4 --kernel=auto --runs=2000 --kv-warm=false
```
and also with `--kv-warm=true` to compare.
eva: I can run that on a dev GPU in ~20m and post logs.
alex: thanks. if evan's runs confirm, we should gate a rollback for the selector change and revert PR #4321 until we understand.
priya: before rolling back, can we try forcing kernel=v1 in canary for a small %? patching routing policy might be faster.
dan: agree. I'll push a canary override that pins kernel=flashattn_v1 for 10% of traffic in us-west and monitor p95.
infra-bot: deploy queued: patch/selector-override -> canary (10%) by dan. ETA ~6m.
bench-bot: please include perf sampling: `nsys profile --sample=cpu,gpu` on one of the canary nodes.
eva: ran local reproducer. Results:
```
--kv-warm=false--
flash_v1 median: 8.0ms p95: 13.2ms
flash_v2 median: 12.4ms p95: 21.1ms
--kv-warm=true--
flash_v1 median: 7.6ms p95: 12.8ms
flash_v2 median: 9.0ms p95: 15.4ms
```
eva: so v2 improves a bit when KV warmed, but still worse on cold paths. suggests some data-dependent path in v2 causing stalls on initial KV misses.
priya: that explains amplification: more cold KV -> worse impact under v2.
alex: good data. plan: (A) canary override to v1 (dan), (B) schedule a micro-bisect of selector/compiler changes in PR window (priya+dan), (C) deeper profiler on v2 hot-loop (eva).
dan: starting canary override now, will post when live.
infra-bot: canary is live (10% us-west). monitoring p95.
bench-bot: canary snapshot: baseline p95=30.2ms -> with override p95=24.5ms after 5m on canary slices.
priya: nice. I'll gather commits between abc123..def456 and start bisecting locally for the kernel compile flags.
ealex: assigning owners: dan (canary + rollback plan), priya (bisect commits & selector logic), eva (nvprof/nsys deep analysis), dan/priya to coord on revert PR if needed.
alex: keep posts short in this thread with numbers. if anything looks like we should roll back across regions, ping SRE and set incident.
priya: will update with bisect result. next step I'll try toggling quantization flag used by selector to see if that alone flips behavior.
dan: if bisect points to compiler/kernel change, we might need a targeted rollback or a hotfix to selector heuristics.
alex: thanks all. tagging @oncall in case it widens: @oncall :wave:
